q: In a tenant verification drive you find a family without citizenship papers pleading long residence and Aadhaar as proof of citizenship. Local group demands immediate deportation entry.
options: Declare them foreigners and push them across border on your order
Record factual report, seize no citizenship finding, forward to competent authority for determination
Accept Aadhaar as citizenship and close verification
Detain family indefinitely till they produce old land records
expl: SI only verifies facts; citizenship rests with designated authority.
why: Citizenship is acquired and decided under statute by competent authority, not police or mob. On verification the SI must report facts and protect liberty pending decision.
trapnote: Trap: Aadhaar equals citizenship and SI can deport.

q: A railway canteen contractor assaults a passenger and your constable says no constitutional remedy applies as contractor is private.
options: Close case as private dispute with no state link
Treat contractor performing public function as covered and proceed with criminal and remedial action
Ask railways to cancel licence yourself without enquiry
Advise victim to sue contractor civilly only
expl: Instrumentality performing state function counts as State for rights remedy.
why: Definition of State extends to agencies and private bodies doing public functions under control. On platform duty the SI must enforce criminal law and trigger departmental action.
trapnote: Trap: private label shields public-function abuse.

q: On election duty a constable refuses posting at a minority booth saying secularism means keeping distance from all religions.
options: Exempt him to respect his conscience reading
Reject plea, deploy neutrally and ensure equal protection to all voters
Post only majority staff there to avoid complaint
Withdraw picket from that booth
expl: Secularism means neutrality and equal protection, not avoidance.
why: Preamble goals of secularism, equality and fraternity require neutral state aid to all faiths. On polls the SI must deploy impartially and act against intimidation.
trapnote: Trap: secularism misread as avoidance of minority area.

q: Two brothers claim opposite citizenship status based on birth in India to foreign parents. Both demand you write final nationality in verification form.
options: Write both as citizens as birth in India is enough
Leave final finding to authority, record birth, parentage and residence facts accurately
Write both as foreigners to be safe
Demand bribe for favourable entry
expl: Birth rules turn on dates and parentage under statute.
why: Citizenship by birth depends on statutory cut-offs and exceptions, not mere birthplace. On verification the SI must collect documents and forward, avoiding premature declaration.
trapnote: Trap: pushes SI to decide settled law on disputed facts.

q: After custodial roughing up, your staff says preamble promises are only ideals with no role in lockup management.
options: Accept as ideals have no lockup application
Apply justice, dignity and due procedure in custody management and medical documentation
Hide injuries to protect station reputation
Shift blame to victim for resisting
expl: Preamble justice and dignity demand humane custody and accountability.
why: Preamble declares justice and dignity as governing aims for all state action. In custody the SI must ensure safety, memo injuries and produce promptly.
